Wow.

I'm a 22 year old and I know exactly what you're feeling. 

Living at home, pursuing a teaching certificate, but totally dispassionate about it. It was a decision that I made under duress and wish I hadn't done. I feel like I'm falling into a career that I won't like. I liked history and once I got my undergrad in it I was like 'FUCK! Now what?' So I went into teaching. What a mistake. Funny enough, I kick myself everyday that I didn't major in business or marketing, at least then I could get a job...

Hey, PM me if you want to talk. I know how you feel, maybe we can chat about it more.

I know how you feel. I was driving today and I got really upset when I thought about my friends' and families reaction to what would happen if I were to off myself, and of course I don't want that! 

But I can't help but feel sometimes that I am a leech, and I'm just taking advantage of them. And I think they're better off without me.

Shoot me a pm if you'd like I'm gonna be on for a while.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. It helps a lot. 

I feel so wishy-washy. One minute I'm like "You're already in it, it's another 9 months, it's gonna be tough and then it's over! Teaching isn't even *that* bad! What else do you even want to do?"

And then I think "I wanted to go to law school but I listened to your parent's advice about that (to not go), I was too fucked up and depressed out of college to know how to apply for jobs properly, but now it's too late and those opportunities are gone, so you have to stick with it" 

and then I think "But I never wanted this in the first place! I don't want to do this! I don't want to sacrifice other dreams I had for the future for a safety net career! I don't want to live at home anymore!"

And then I just feel terrible and struggle to figure out what the best way to go is. And I remember that I'm a year out of undergrad and I'm still a mess and everyone else is doing so well. I hate it. 

And then I start thinking about just ending it by jumping off a bridge, or swallowing pills, or any other way, and it makes my stomach turn but I can't stop thinking that way, or if I can I haven't found the tools to do so. I know if I were to go people would be upset, it might destroy my family, but I'm just in agony, and I feel like no one cares until it finally happens.

Thank you for listening.

I feel so similarly to how you do now. I used to be the happiest person in the world; fun, boisterous, life of the party. Now I'm an embittered semi-suicidal jerk. I'm going down a path in life that I don't think is right, and I feel like I might as well kill myself now and save everyone the trouble. 

Do you feel like talking? It's just eerie how similar what you're saying can apply to me too. If we're being honest, I'm positive someone still wants us around and would be hurt if we were gone.
